description: The Search runtime query monitoring API's View Active Node/Index Queries responses key each active query by a hyphenated string combining a node UUID and an integer ID (e.g. 'b91d75480470f979f65f04e8f20a1f7b-17'), but the Cancel Active Queries endpoint's queryID path parameter is typed and exampled as a bare Integer ('24'), with the node UUID supplied separately in the request body. The page never states how a caller is meant to split the hyphenated map key returned by the list endpoints into the two separate values the cancel endpoint expects.
